name: GCD Sum
justification: Clean aha (one of any 3 consecutive numbers works via divisibility by 3); tiny code, single-number output.
solution_sketch: Digit sum mod 3 equals n mod 3, so among n, n+1, n+2 one is divisible by 3 along with its digit sum. Just check those three with gcd(x, digitsum(x))>1.
